editionLabel: Looney Labs English Homeworlds booklet, 16 PDF spreads
firstPlayerRule: If the players are evenly matched in skill, flip a coin. Otherwise, the less experienced player begins.
officialTieBreak: A coin flip chooses the starter when the players' skills are evenly matched.
clarifications: The game opens with a setup round in which each player chooses their Homeworld stars and initial ship.
